name: Naftopidil

similar.name: Propranolol
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm

summary: A small computer model, not tests on people, gave Naftopidil a low risk score of 37 for liver problems and a high risk score of 74 for heart issues [M]. The drug itself has no listed problems of its own in these records [1][2]. However, a similar drug named Propranolol carries a boxed warning in the United States for heart harm [3].
